name: BufferOver TLS dataset (tls.bufferover.run)
tier_rationale: Small operator without a verifiable company identity, terms or privacy policy reviewed by legal; council P007 cond 1 (legal_dpo floor) keeps BufferOver unknown tier: opt-in module, excluded at TLP:AMBER and above (A8).

reliability.justification: TLS-scan derived 'ip,hostname' records of unknown freshness: single-source names stay unconfirmed until they resolve or a second source agrees.

bufferover.plan_hint: business = a company/team account on a plan whose terms permit internal business use, recorded by legal (never an analyst's personal free account, P007 cond 3); key_plans.bufferover='business' unlocks it under the corporate profile

dns.title: BufferOver TLS records of a domain (GET /dns?q=.{domain})

terms.quote: P007 cond 3 (binding council text): key-terms per adapter - a company/team account, never an analyst's personal free account, on a plan whose terms permit internal business use; legal records the plan and the terms URL in the registry before the adapter runs under the corporate profile (A1).

dns.notes: Research C0045 (verified_needs_key: 403 without key). Records are comma-separated 'ip,...,hostname' strings in Results[] (legacy FDNS_A[]/RDNS[]): the IP is split from the host name (P007 cond 4) and kept as evidence only; Meta.Errors inside an HTTP 200 is an error. The day figure of the quota block is an interim budget (plan limits unpublished). Used by subdomains_keyed_minor.

notes: Owned by batch p3-G01-1 (P007, module subdomains_keyed_minor).
